description: Start a Google PageSpeed check of how fast a website loads on phones and computers (mobile and desktop). A finished result is saved and reused for seven days. The user is never charged. This check has a limited daily allowance shared by everyone, so it may be unavailable later in the day; the result then says quota_reached with the reset time (UTC). For a running result, call get_audit_report with runId. That call waits up to about 40 seconds for the run to finish before it answers. Repeat while status is running. Cached completed results need no polling.

url.description: Website URL, http or https. The scheme is optional.

name: check_site_speed
title: Check site speed
